shortDescription: The Bank of England’s plan to slow the pace of its bond sales will ease pressure on repo operations and support strained long-end gilts, according to a Barclays Plc strategist, Bloomberg reported.

title: Barclays Says BOE Bond-Sale Slowdown Will Ease Repo Pressure
